messages:
Maya: heads up — planning a thermal-slim quant kernel deploy tonight in the quiet window (23:30-02:30 PT). staging passed smoke. planning canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 30m slices.
Tony: what's pinned for prod? model-quant-v3 or model-quant-v3-slim?
Maya: will serve model-quant-v3-slim + kernel v2.11. ABI compatible with v2.10 but changed matmul kernel.
Olga: deploy-bot scheduled? any sticky pins?
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled by Maya for 2025-09-12T23:30:00Z. Canary slices: 1%,10%,50%. Auto-rollback: enabled.
Tony: recommend pin TTL 2h after canary completes, then auto-unpin. If we see p50 latency +40ms or error rate +3% -> rollback. Also watch kv-cache hit rate.
Liz: adding rollback triggers: 1) error-rate increase >2% absolute, 2) p95 increase >100ms, 3) spurious NaN logits >0.05% — if any fired, abort and roll back.
Maya: agreed. putting in release notes. link: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/thermal-slim-quant
Olga: who runs the unpin if everything good?
Tony: I'll run `deployctl pin --service inference --ver kernel:v2.11 --ttl 2h` after canary. Command:
```
# pin for safe window
deployctl pin --service inference --variant kernel:v2.11 --scope production --ttl 2h
```
Maya: canary metrics to watch: p50, p95, error rate, kv miss, memory OOMs. I'll post dashboard snapshot before start.
Maya: @Liz can you do smoke eval set `eval/thermal-slim/smoke-12` just at canary 1%?
Liz: on it. will post results in 10m.
cicd-bot: baked image `engine:v2.11-slim` passed unit + integration.
Tony: note: if deploybot shows rollout stalled at 10% for >20m, don't escalate — let battery drain probe run 5m then escalate to oncall.
Maya: okay. release notes draft updated — small perf improvement for short-context generation, known variance on long sequences (documented). pinging @oncall for standby.
Olga: copying rollback playbook snippet for whoever is oncall:
```
# rollback
deployctl rollback --service inference --to kernel:v2.10
notify ops-channel "rollback kernel v2.11 -> v2.10 due to metrics"
```
Maya: thanks. will run final preflight at 23:00 PT.
Liz: smoke eval passed: latency p50 down 12%, p95 +15ms, error-rate unchanged. LGTM :thumbsup: 
Tony: I'll be oncall during window. set timer.
Maya: starting canary 1% in 15m. copying summary to release notes and release PR.
Olga: uploaded release notes draft: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pulls/427
deploy-bot: canary 1% started (slice id c-985). monitor: https://dash.internal/redwood/d/engine/thermal-slim
Maya: canary 1% smoke looks ok. proceeding to 10% in 10m.
Tony: watching. no anomalies so far.
Maya: 10% -> 50% progression scheduled, will update.
deploy-bot: canary progressed to 10% (slice c-986).
Liz: quick check — no OOMs, kv-miss stable.
Maya: progressing to 50% now.
deploy-bot: canary progressed to 50% (slice c-987).
Tony: at 50% p95 spike +110ms observed in edge region us-west-2, error-rate +0.6% absolute. threshold? we set p95>100ms triggers rollback. Recommend pause and investigate region isolate.
Maya: pausing rollout. reverting 50% slice to 10% traffic. tagging for rollback-if-degraded.
Olga: initiating targeted rollback for us-west-2 only.
Tony: running rollback steps for region:
```
deployctl rollback --service inference --region us-west-2 --to kernel:v2.10
```
cicd-bot: rollback initiated for region us-west-2.
Maya: monitoring — metrics trending back to baseline. opening incident if not normalized in 15m.
Liz: will run deeper eval on sample logs.
Tony: once stable, we should document canary failure root cause: matmul thermal scaling on older driver nodes.
Maya: logged follow-up ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/RUN-512-thermal-slim-driver-compat
Olga: we should also update release notes: "rolled back partial region due to p95 spike; investigating driver compatibility; no user-facing errors."
Maya: agreed. marking release as paused. will reschedule next quiet window after driver patch.
Tony: thanks all. will unpin any temporary pins tomorrow morning.
Maya: thread closed for now. will reopen if anything else.
